welcome_page.title: Driving
welcome_page.description:
This questionnaire is about your experience of driving a car. It takes about 3 minutes.

Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your answers have been saved. Thank you for your time.

If you had free access to a shared bike or e-scooter, would you use it?

options.text: Shorter or more reliable travel times

it.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Le tue risposte sono state salvate. Grazie per il tuo tempo.
it.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Alcune domande veloci per inquadrare le tue risposte.
it.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Guidi l'auto almeno una volta a settimana?
it.#<p>Think about the times you drive a ca: Pensa alle volte in cui guidi l'auto.
it.#How stressful are delays caused by traf: Quanto sono stressanti i ritardi dovuti a traffico o incidenti?
it.#How much do these delays disrupt your d: Quanto questi ritardi disturbano la tua giornata?
it.#How often do you change route or depart: Quanto spesso cambi percorso o orario di partenza a causa del traffico?
it.#How big a problem is finding parking at: Quanto è un problema trovare parcheggio a destinazione?
it.#What do parking difficulties make you d: Cosa ti fanno fare le difficoltà di parcheggio? (Al massimo 2)
it.#The trip is less convenient or more str: Lo spostamento è più scomodo o stressante
it.#I use another way of travelling: Uso un altro modo di spostarmi
it.#When you drive, how often do parked car: Quando guidi, quanto spesso le auto parcheggiate ti impediscono di vedere i pedoni che stanno per attraversare?
it.#If driving costs (fuel, tolls, parking): Se i costi di guida (carburante, pedaggi, parcheggio) aumentassero, come cambierebbe il tuo uso dell'auto?
it.#I'd stop using it for most trips: Smetterei di usarla per la maggior parte degli spostamenti
it.#How much do you think about pollution w: Quanto pensi all'inquinamento quando decidi di prendere l'auto?
it.#Compared to other ways of travelling, h: Rispetto ad altri modi di spostarti, quanto è comoda per te l'auto?
it.#If you had free access to a shared bike: Se avessi accesso gratuito a una bici o a un monopattino in sharing, lo useresti?
it.#What would encourage you to walk, cycle: Cosa ti incoraggerebbe a camminare, andare in bici o usare lo sharing più spesso? (Al massimo 3)
it.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Tempi più brevi o più affidabili
it.#<p>This questionnaire is about your exp:
Questo questionario riguarda la tua esperienza alla guida dell'auto. Richiede circa 3 minuti.

La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Vos réponses ont été enregistrées. Merci pour votre temps.
fr.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Quelques questions rapides pour mettre vos réponses en contexte.
fr.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Conduisez-vous une voiture au moins une fois par semaine ?
fr.#<p>Think about the times you drive a ca: Pensez aux moments où vous conduisez une voiture.
fr.#How stressful are delays caused by traf: À quel point les retards dus à la circulation ou aux accidents sont-ils stressants ?
fr.#How much do these delays disrupt your d: Dans quelle mesure ces retards perturbent-ils votre emploi du temps quotidien ?
fr.#How often do you change route or depart: À quelle fréquence changez-vous d’itinéraire ou d’heure de départ à cause de la circulation ?
fr.#How big a problem is finding parking at: Dans quelle mesure trouver une place de stationnement à destination est-il un problème ?
fr.#What do parking difficulties make you d: Que vous font faire les difficultés de stationnement ? (2 au maximum)
fr.#The trip is less convenient or more str: Le trajet est moins pratique ou plus stressant
fr.#I change route or destination: Je change d’itinéraire ou de destination
fr.#I postpone or cancel some trips: Je reporte ou j’annule certains trajets
fr.#I use another way of travelling: J’utilise un autre moyen de déplacement
fr.#When you drive, how often do parked car: Lorsque vous conduisez, à quelle fréquence les voitures stationnées vous empêchent-elles de voir les piétons sur le point de traverser ?
fr.#If driving costs (fuel, tolls, parking): Si les coûts de la voiture (carburant, péages, stationnement) augmentaient, comment votre utilisation de la voiture changerait-elle ?
fr.#I'd stop using it for most trips: J’arrêterais de l’utiliser pour la plupart de mes déplacements
fr.#How much do you think about pollution w: Dans quelle mesure pensez-vous à la pollution lorsque vous décidez de prendre la voiture ?
fr.#Compared to other ways of travelling, h: Par rapport aux autres modes de déplacement, dans quelle mesure la voiture est-elle confortable pour vous ?
fr.#If you had free access to a shared bike: Si vous aviez un accès gratuit à un vélo ou à une trottinette électrique en libre-service, l’utiliseriez-vous ?
fr.#What would encourage you to walk, cycle: Qu’est-ce qui vous encouragerait à marcher, à faire du vélo ou à utiliser les services partagés plus souvent ? (3 au maximum)
fr.#Better pavements and cycle lanes: De meilleurs trottoirs et pistes cyclables
fr.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Des temps de trajet plus courts ou plus fiables
fr.#More comfort and convenience: Plus de confort et de praticité
fr.#Feeling more confident using them: Me sentir plus à l’aise pour les utiliser
fr.#<p>This questionnaire is about your exp:
Ce questionnaire porte sur votre expérience de la conduite automobile. Il prend environ 3 minutes.

La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas liées à votre nom. Elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Ihre Antworten wurden gespeichert. Vielen Dank für Ihre Zeit.
de.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Ein paar kurze Fragen, um Ihre Antworten einzuordnen.
de.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Fahren Sie mindestens einmal pro Woche Auto?
de.#<p>Think about the times you drive a ca: Denken Sie an die Situationen, in denen Sie Auto fahren.
de.#How stressful are delays caused by traf: Wie belastend sind Verzögerungen durch Verkehr oder Unfälle?
de.#How much do these delays disrupt your d: Wie stark stören diese Verzögerungen Ihren Tagesablauf?
de.#How often do you change route or depart: Wie oft ändern Sie wegen des Verkehrs Ihre Route oder Abfahrtszeit?
de.#How big a problem is finding parking at: Wie groß ist das Problem, an Ihrem Ziel einen Parkplatz zu finden?
de.#What do parking difficulties make you d: Wozu führen Parkschwierigkeiten bei Ihnen? (Bis zu 2)
de.#The trip is less convenient or more str: Die Fahrt ist weniger bequem oder stressiger
de.#I postpone or cancel some trips: Ich verschiebe oder streiche manche Fahrten
de.#I use another way of travelling: Ich nutze eine andere Art der Fortbewegung
de.#When you drive, how often do parked car: Wie oft verhindern geparkte Autos beim Autofahren, dass Sie Fußgänger/innen sehen, die gerade die Straße überqueren wollen?
de.#If driving costs (fuel, tolls, parking): Wenn die Kosten des Autofahrens (Kraftstoff, Maut, Parken) steigen würden, wie würde sich Ihre Autonutzung ändern?
de.#I'd use it a little less: Ich würde es etwas weniger nutzen
de.#I'd use it quite a bit less: Ich würde es deutlich weniger nutzen
de.#I'd use it much less: Ich würde es viel weniger nutzen
de.#I'd stop using it for most trips: Ich würde es für die meisten Wege nicht mehr nutzen
de.#How much do you think about pollution w: Wie sehr denken Sie an die Umweltverschmutzung, wenn Sie sich entscheiden, das Auto zu nehmen?
de.#Compared to other ways of travelling, h: Wie bequem ist das Auto für Sie im Vergleich zu anderen Fortbewegungsarten?
de.#If you had free access to a shared bike: Wenn Sie kostenlosen Zugang zu einem Leihfahrrad oder Leih-E-Scooter hätten, würden Sie ihn nutzen?
de.#What would encourage you to walk, cycle: Was würde Sie dazu ermutigen, öfter zu Fuß zu gehen, Rad zu fahren oder Sharing-Angebote zu nutzen? (Bis zu 3)
de.#<p>This questionnaire is about your exp:
Dieser Fragebogen befasst sich mit Ihren Erfahrungen beim Autofahren. Er dauert etwa 3 Minuten.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft. Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf verschiedene SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

tr.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Yanıtlarınızı bağlamına oturtmak için birkaç kısa soru.
tr.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Haftada en az bir kez araba kullanıyor musunuz?
tr.#How stressful are delays caused by traf: Trafik veya kazalardan kaynaklanan gecikmeler ne kadar stresli?
tr.#How much do these delays disrupt your d: Bu gecikmeler günlük programınızı ne kadar aksatıyor?
tr.#How often do you change route or depart: Trafik nedeniyle ne sıklıkla güzergâhınızı veya çıkış saatinizi değiştiriyorsunuz?
tr.#How big a problem is finding parking at: Varış noktanızda park yeri bulmak ne kadar büyük bir sorun?
tr.#What do parking difficulties make you d: Park sorunları size ne yaptırıyor? (En fazla 2)
tr.#The trip is less convenient or more str: Yolculuk daha zahmetli veya daha stresli oluyor
tr.#I postpone or cancel some trips: Bazı yolculukları erteliyor veya iptal ediyorum
tr.#When you drive, how often do parked car: Araba kullanırken park etmiş arabalar, karşıya geçmek üzere olan yayaları görmenizi ne sıklıkla engelliyor?
tr.#If driving costs (fuel, tolls, parking): Araba kullanma maliyetleri (yakıt, geçiş ücretleri, park) artsaydı, araba kullanımınız nasıl değişirdi?
tr.#How much do you think about pollution w: Arabayı kullanmaya karar verirken kirliliği ne kadar düşünüyorsunuz?
tr.#Compared to other ways of travelling, h: Diğer ulaşım biçimleriyle karşılaştırıldığında araba sizin için ne kadar rahat?
tr.#If you had free access to a shared bike: Paylaşımlı bir bisiklete veya elektrikli scootera ücretsiz erişiminiz olsaydı, kullanır mıydınız?
tr.#What would encourage you to walk, cycle: Daha sık yürümeniz, bisiklet sürmeniz veya paylaşımlı araçları kullanmanız için sizi ne teşvik ederdi? (En fazla 3)
tr.#Better pavements and cycle lanes: Daha iyi kaldırımlar ve bisiklet yolları
tr.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Daha kısa veya daha güvenilir yolculuk süreleri
tr.#Feeling more confident using them: Bunları kullanırken kendimi daha güvende hissetmek
tr.#<p>This questionnaire is about your exp:
Bu anket, araba kullanma deneyiminizle ilgilidir. Yaklaşık 3 dakika sürer.

Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez. Yanıtlarınız, e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma bir kodla saklanır; böylece farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtlar birlikte analiz edilebilir.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi

fa.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: پاسخ‌های شما ذخیره شد. از وقتی که گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: چند پرسش کوتاه برای قراردادن پاسخ‌های شما در بستر مناسب.
fa.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: آیا دست‌کم هفته‌ای یک‌بار رانندگی می‌کنید؟
fa.#<p>Think about the times you drive a ca: به زمان‌هایی فکر کنید که رانندگی می‌کنید.
fa.#How stressful are delays caused by traf: تأخیرهای ناشی از ترافیک یا تصادف چقدر استرس‌زا هستند؟
fa.#How much do these delays disrupt your d: این تأخیرها چقدر برنامه روزانه شما را به هم می‌زنند؟
fa.#How often do you change route or depart: چند وقت یک‌بار به‌خاطر ترافیک مسیر یا زمان حرکت خود را تغییر می‌دهید؟
fa.#How big a problem is finding parking at: پیداکردن جای پارک در مقصد چقدر برای شما مشکل است؟
fa.#What do parking difficulties make you d: دشواری پیداکردن جای پارک شما را به چه کاری وامی‌دارد؟ (حداکثر ۲ مورد)
fa.#I change route or destination: مسیر یا مقصد را تغییر می‌دهم
fa.#I postpone or cancel some trips: برخی سفرها را به تعویق می‌اندازم یا لغو می‌کنم
fa.#I use another way of travelling: از روش دیگری برای جابه‌جایی استفاده می‌کنم
fa.#When you drive, how often do parked car: وقتی رانندگی می‌کنید، چند وقت یک‌بار خودروهای پارک‌شده مانع از دیدن عابرانی می‌شوند که می‌خواهند از خیابان عبور کنند؟
fa.#If driving costs (fuel, tolls, parking): اگر هزینه‌های رانندگی (سوخت، عوارض، پارکینگ) افزایش می‌یافت، استفاده شما از خودرو چگونه تغییر می‌کرد؟
fa.#I'd use it quite a bit less: به‌طور قابل توجهی کمتر استفاده می‌کردم
fa.#I'd stop using it for most trips: برای بیشتر سفرها دیگر از آن استفاده نمی‌کردم
fa.#How much do you think about pollution w: وقتی تصمیم می‌گیرید با خودرو بروید، چقدر به آلودگی فکر می‌کنید؟
fa.#Compared to other ways of travelling, h: در مقایسه با روش‌های دیگر جابه‌جایی، خودرو برای شما چقدر راحت است؟
fa.#If you had free access to a shared bike: اگر به دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی اشتراکی دسترسی رایگان داشتید، از آن استفاده می‌کردید؟
fa.#What would encourage you to walk, cycle: چه چیزی شما را تشویق می‌کرد بیشتر پیاده‌روی کنید، دوچرخه‌سواری کنید یا از سرویس‌های اشتراکی استفاده کنید؟ (حداکثر ۳ مورد)
fa.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: زمان سفر کوتاه‌تر یا قابل اعتمادتر
fa.#Feeling more confident using them: احساس اطمینان بیشتر هنگام استفاده از آن‌ها
fa.#<p>This questionnaire is about your exp:
این پرسشنامه درباره تجربه شما از رانندگی با خودرو است. تکمیل آن حدود ۳ دقیقه طول می‌کشد.

مشارکت داوطلبانه است. پاسخ‌های شما به نام شما مرتبط نمی‌شود. پاسخ‌ها با یک کد مستعار که از نشانی ایمیل شما ساخته می‌شود ذخیره می‌شوند، تا پاسخ‌های شما به پرسشنامه‌های مختلف SmartUrbanity بتوانند با هم تحلیل شوند.

اطلاعات بیشتر درباره SmartUrbanity

hu.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: Válaszait elmentettük. Köszönjük, hogy időt szánt ránk.
hu.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: Néhány gyors kérdés, hogy válaszait összefüggéseiben lássuk.
hu.#<p>Think about the times you drive a ca: Gondoljon azokra az alkalmakra, amikor autót vezet.
hu.#How stressful are delays caused by traf: Mennyire stresszesek a forgalom vagy balesetek okozta késések?
hu.#How much do these delays disrupt your d: Mennyire zavarják meg ezek a késések a napi időbeosztását?
hu.#How often do you change route or depart: Milyen gyakran változtat útvonalat vagy indulási időt a forgalom miatt?
hu.#How big a problem is finding parking at: Mekkora gondot jelent parkolóhelyet találni az úti célnál?
hu.#What do parking difficulties make you d: Mire késztetik Önt a parkolási nehézségek? (Legfeljebb 2)
hu.#The trip is less convenient or more str: Az út kényelmetlenebb vagy stresszesebb lesz
hu.#When you drive, how often do parked car: Amikor vezet, milyen gyakran akadályozzák a parkoló autók abban, hogy lássa az átkelni készülő gyalogosokat?
hu.#If driving costs (fuel, tolls, parking): Ha az autózás költségei (üzemanyag, útdíjak, parkolás) emelkednének, hogyan változna az autóhasználata?
hu.#I'd stop using it for most trips: A legtöbb úthoz felhagynék a használatával
hu.#How much do you think about pollution w: Mennyire gondol a környezetszennyezésre, amikor úgy dönt, hogy autóval megy?
hu.#Compared to other ways of travelling, h: Más közlekedési módokhoz képest mennyire kényelmes Önnek az autó?
hu.#If you had free access to a shared bike: Ha ingyenesen hozzáférne egy közösségi kerékpárhoz vagy elektromos rollerhez, használná?
hu.#What would encourage you to walk, cycle: Mi ösztönözné arra, hogy gyakrabban gyalogoljon, kerékpározzon vagy használjon megosztott járműveket? (Legfeljebb 3)
hu.#<p>This questionnaire is about your exp:
Ez a kérdőív az autóvezetéssel kapcsolatos tapasztalatairól szól. Kitöltése körülbelül 3 percet vesz igénybe.

A részvétel önkéntes. Válaszai nem kapcsolódnak a nevéhez. Az e-mail-címéből képzett álnevesített kód alatt tároljuk őket, hogy a különböző SmartUrbanity kérdőívekre adott válaszait együtt lehessen elemezni.

Tudjon meg többet a SmartUrbanity projektről

ar.#<p>Your answers have been saved. Thank: تم حفظ إجاباتك. شكرًا لك على وقتك.
ar.#<p>A few quick questions to put your an: بضعة أسئلة سريعة لوضع إجاباتك في سياقها.
ar.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: هل تقود سيارة مرة واحدة في الأسبوع على الأقل؟
ar.#<p>Think about the times you drive a ca: فكّر في الأوقات التي تقود فيها السيارة.
ar.#How stressful are delays caused by traf: ما مدى التوتر الذي تسببه التأخيرات الناجمة عن حركة المرور أو الحوادث؟
ar.#How much do these delays disrupt your d: إلى أي مدى تُربك هذه التأخيرات جدولك اليومي؟
ar.#How often do you change route or depart: كم مرة تغيّر مسارك أو وقت انطلاقك بسبب حركة المرور؟
ar.#How big a problem is finding parking at: ما مدى صعوبة إيجاد موقف للسيارة عند وجهتك؟
ar.#What do parking difficulties make you d: ماذا تدفعك صعوبات إيجاد موقف إلى فعله؟ (حتى خيارين)
ar.#The trip is less convenient or more str: تصبح الرحلة أقل راحة أو أكثر توترًا
ar.#When you drive, how often do parked car: عندما تقود السيارة، كم مرة تمنعك السيارات المتوقفة من رؤية المشاة الذين يوشكون على العبور؟
ar.#If driving costs (fuel, tolls, parking): إذا ارتفعت تكاليف القيادة (الوقود، رسوم الطرق، مواقف السيارات)، فكيف سيتغير استخدامك للسيارة؟
